nl: Which files under inbox/ (recursively) are not valid UTF-8? List their names.
oracle_program: find "inbox" type: file |> info details: true |> filter encoding not in ["utf-8", "ascii"]
reference_bash: find inbox -type f | while IFS= read -r f; do iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$f"; done
